answer: Locks are entered in dawn, expire in pearl, and ivory lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 172 aliases as a result needs 178 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1706 identities would post 3333 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
